title: Ridgeline Warranty Coverage Weekend Rate for Missed Visits
content:
A missed technician visit under Warranty Coverage takes a day rate set by the day of the week it was booked for:

| Day of the missed visit | Day rate |
|---|---|
| Sunday | 1.5 |
| Saturday | 1.25 |
| Monday to Friday | none — no weekend rate applies |

## Reading the day

- The day is that of the missed visit's date, as recorded on the visit, which is also the date the no-show fee carries.
- Days of the week follow the ordinary calendar; for reference, 4 January 2026 was a Sunday.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Missed visit dated | Day of the week | Day rate |
|---|---|---|
| 5 January 2031 | Sunday | 1.5 |
| 11 January 2031 | Saturday | 1.25 |
| 8 January 2031 | Wednesday | none |
| 12 January 2031 | Sunday | 1.5 |

Two missed visits on the same claim, one on a Saturday and one on a Tuesday, take 1.25 and no weekend rate respectively; each visit takes the rate of its own day.
